premises.text: Status-quo synthetic pesticides are being banned and natural waxes struggle to scale
premises.evidence_span: even though there are natural waxes available that might come from plant or insect compounds, scaling up these solutions is a real challenge

premises.text: Glucose-based fungal biopolymer plus strain-produced antimicrobials form an edible protective coating
premises.evidence_span: The coating is made of a glucose-based biopolymer produced by fungi and naturally occurring antimicrobials produced by different strains

premises.text: Coating delays ripening, controls decay comparably to synthetic fungicides, and extends shelf life
Applicators need no special equipment because the coating runs on existing packing lines
premises.evidence_span: The product integrates seamlessly with existing machinery, so there is no need to invest in special equipment

premises.text: Stable cell-free formulations avoid the storage and logistics burdens of living microbes
premises.evidence_span: they use living microbes in their formulations, which require special storage and logistic conditions. Our cell-free formulations are stable and can be easily stored

premises.text: Initial commercial focus is Latin America's most exported fruit classes: citrus, avocados, and berries
premises.evidence_span: we're targeting the most exported fruit classes in Latin America, which are citrus, avocados, and berries

value.text: Natural protection that reduces food waste while keeping produce marketable
value.evidence_span: help fight against food waste and food insecurity without compromising human or planetary health

causal_links.evidence_span: food waste is such a huge issue

notes: Efficacy, ripening delay, and shelf-life claims merged into P3 as one coating-performance condition. Target-crop focus kept with packhouse fit as commercial/deployment module. Team credentials and $3.5B market framing excluded.
